_comment: Single source of truth for which form (40-mark part) a student does, by the last digit of the student ID. Edit ONLY this file when the rule changes, then run: python3 scripts/check_forms.py (it fails if any worksheet, slide, syllabus or submission text disagrees). The answer-sheet generators in instructor/tools read this file too.
_base_odd: Form done by an ODD last digit in a normal week; an EVEN digit does the other form (0 counts as even).
_flip_from_week: From this week on, every ODD-numbered week swaps the two forms (3, 5, 7, ...). Earlier weeks and even-numbered weeks use base_odd.
_no_form_weeks: Weeks with no form split (review, midterm). Any mapping statement found in these weeks is reported.
